decisive_spans.text: Fungal skin culture: black yeastlike colonies characteristic of Exophiala spinifera species

response.rationale: The presence of black yeastlike colonies characteristic of Exophiala spinifera species on fungal skin culture and pigmented hyphae are direct and specific support for Phaeohyphomycosis. While other diagnoses have some supporting features, none have such direct and specific evidence.
